title: How Overpowered a Second Job Really Is (The Math)
description:
I remember sitting in a diner. The kind where the waitress calls you "hun", the booths are duct-taped and the ketchup bottles need a firm slap. 

My bacon cheeseburger arrived. It smelled like heaven.
But I couldn’t taste a thing. 
I was staring at my napkin. 

Six months from graduating college. I had a job offer. And not just for any job, my dream job. Merrill Lynch. “Wall Street.” Just shy of six figures.

But the napkin didn’t care about dreams.
Sprawled out in chicken scratch was the sad truth. 
$94.5K salary 
$3K/month expenses
8%/year return

It would take me 20+ years to reach financial freedom. Hell, even at 10% returns it takes a lifetime. 

There had to be a better way.
And lucky for me, it took less than a year to find it:
Overemployment. 
My loophole. 
My escape hatch.

Because life’s too short to grind for 20 years just to breathe. 

P.S. I’m finally home after Houston  New Orleans  Philly.
Only U.S. city left on my list is Atlanta.
And honestly? Nothing beats slipping back into a well-oiled routine.
